# STEP INTO YOUR SKELETON & STEP ONTO YOUR MAT
**Safer Practice. Smarter Movement. Deeper Learning.**

At **HOLO-BODY**, we believe that a deeper understanding of human anatomy and proper alignment is key to reducing injuries and improving performance during yoga practice. 

Traditional mats and apps don’t address what’s happening **INSIDE** the body. That’s why we created a virtual holographic instructor that makes learning yoga intuitive and **FUN!**
